default/31862.htm.text: Angelic Vortex: The Angelic Vortex emits a faint light, and in the midst of the light an image appears. In the deepest part of a specious area, a gigantic stone statue is visible. The statue has a human-like appearance and is in a seated position, as though it was being held by some invisible force…

links.text: Go where the Angelic Vortex leads.
